title: Campaign Reconciliation Report v0
description: One comparison of a CampaignSpec (desired state) against an Admin API readback (observed state). Verdicts are exact-only and the vocabulary is closed. Rows this source cannot observe are classed `unsupported` and COUNTED, never dropped: a report must never present 'nothing to report' and 'nothing was checked' as the same result. A page may reference one package at several quantities (a bundle picker), so the compared unit is a SELECTION ENTRY and many entries may bind to one live package; quantity belongs to the entry and is spec-side, not an API gap. Comparison rules: docs/reconcile-comparison-matrix-v0.md.

outcome.description: Partial or truncated input is always `inconclusive` — never a difference, which would imply a comparison that did not happen.

matrix_hash.description: Hash of the comparison matrix revision these verdicts were produced under.

price_basis.description: Observed package prices are list prices. Offers are applied downstream and are not part of this observation source (Admin API Offers endpoints are in development; offers are readable today via the storefront Campaign Retrieve API).

coverage_complete.description: True only when every matrix row was evaluated or explicitly classified, input was whole, and no binding was left unresolved. `unsupported` and `not_asserted` rows do NOT reduce coverage — they are accounted.

accounted_row_count.description: Rows classed `unsupported` or `not_asserted`: seen and deliberately not judged.

qty.description: Selection quantity, present on entry-level rows.

offers_asserted.description: True when the spec asserts any offer, so a reader knows list price and charged price provably differ for this campaign.
